title: Antimicrobial Resistance Tracking and Fate Modeling in the Urban Flows-Lake Interface (ARTFUL)
description: This BioProject contains Oxford Nanopore 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data generated from wastewater effluent and freshwater samples collected during Winter 2023 and Spring 2024 from the Lausanne Wastewater Treatment Plant (STEP) and Vidy Bay, Lake Geneva, Switzerland respectively. Lake Geneva is a seasonally stratified freshwater ecosystem that receives municipal wastewater inputs from STEP. The dataset was generated as part of the Antimicrobial Resistance Tracking and Fate Modeling in the Urban Flows-Lake Interface (ARTFUL) project to characterise microbial community composition across the wastewater-freshwater interface and support investigations of antimicrobial resistance dissemination in urban aquatic environments.
